title: The financial entity
description: Section 1 of the template: the entity submitting the report, the financial entity affected, and whom to contact. Its mandatory fields are mandatory at every stage.

submitting_entity_name.title: 1.2 Name of the entity submitting the report
submitting_entity_name.description: The full legal name of the entity that submits the report. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

submitting_entity_code.title: 1.3a Identification code of the entity submitting the report
submitting_entity_code.description: The identification code of the entity that submits the report, of the type 1.3b names. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

submitting_entity_code_type.title: 1.3b Type of the identification code of the entity submitting the report
submitting_entity_code_type.description: Which kind of code 1.3a is. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

affected_entity_types.title: 1.4 Type of the affected financial entity
affected_entity_types.description: The kind of financial entity the report is for, as Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 names them; more than one for an aggregated report. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

enum: insurance intermediary, reinsurance intermediary or ancillary insurance intermediary

affected_entity_name.title: 1.5 Name of the financial entity affected
affected_entity_name.description: The full legal name of the affected financial entity, given when it is not the entity submitting the report, and for an aggregated report. Mandatory when its condition holds.

affected_entity_lei.title: 1.6 LEI code of the financial entity affected
affected_entity_lei.description: The legal entity identifier of the affected financial entity, given when 1.5 is. Mandatory when its condition holds.

primary_contact_name.title: 1.7 Primary contact person name
primary_contact_name.description: The person the competent authority contacts first about the incident. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

primary_contact_email.title: 1.8 Primary contact person email
primary_contact_email.description: The primary contact's email address. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

primary_contact_telephone.title: 1.9 Primary contact person telephone
primary_contact_telephone.description: The primary contact's telephone number, in international form. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

second_contact_name.title: 1.10 Second contact person name
second_contact_name.description: The person the competent authority contacts when the primary contact cannot be reached. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

second_contact_email.title: 1.11 Second contact person email
second_contact_email.description: The second contact's email address. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

second_contact_telephone.title: 1.12 Second contact person telephone
second_contact_telephone.description: The second contact's telephone number, in international form. Mandatory in the initial notification, the intermediate report and the final report.

parent_undertaking_name.title: 1.13 Name of the ultimate parent undertaking
parent_undertaking_name.description: The full legal name of the group's ultimate parent undertaking, given when the entity belongs to a group. Mandatory when its condition holds.

parent_undertaking_lei.title: 1.14 LEI code of the ultimate parent undertaking
parent_undertaking_lei.description: The legal entity identifier of the ultimate parent undertaking, given when 1.13 is. Mandatory when its condition holds.

reporting_currency.title: 1.15 Reporting currency
reporting_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency every monetary amount in the report is given in, given when the report holds one. Mandatory when its condition holds.
